text:
ITEM 1 | Square white plate-based meal; a compact mound of golden-orange, crumbly-looking mixture with flecks of red pepper and pale bits, partly covered by bright green leafy pieces (spinach-like leaves), slightly moist surface, roughly 5 x 4 cm footprint and about 2 cm tall, sitting at the upper left of the plate | 60
ITEM 2 | Sliced yellow squash-type pieces: two pale yellow-green wedges with smooth, slightly glossy skin and creamy pale flesh, one about 7 cm long and 2 cm wide, arranged in a fan with a shorter wedge beneath, lightly cooked with soft edges | 70
ITEM 3 | Dark green zucchini-type slices with smooth glossy skin and pale green-white inner flesh, about 6 cm long and 1.5 cm thick, lightly cooked and soft, partly tucked under the yellow wedges | 30
ITEM 4 | Small whole red pepper, about 4 cm long and 2 cm wide, smooth glossy red skin, slightly soft, lying across the yellow squash pieces | 15
ITEM 5 | Small whole yellow-orange pepper, about 4 cm long and 1.5 cm wide, smooth glossy skin with a short green stem tip, lying beside the red pepper | 12
ITEM 6 | Small scattered crumb or bit of pale yellow-tan food, about 0.5 cm, near the lower right of the vegetables | 1
